channel.title: Mauritania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritania, every source cited.

item.title: Mauritania interior minister reviews capital's sanitation
item.description: Minister Mokhtar Ould Ahmed Bousseif met with officials to assess the performance of the contracted cleaning company, Arma.

item.title: Mauritania central bank raises interest rate to 7.25%
item.description: The central bank also increased the mandatory reserve rate for banks from 8% to 15% to combat rising inflation.

item.title: Somelec blames technicians for Nouakchott power pole fires
item.description: Mauritania's electricity company cites unqualified climbers and illegal connections for recurring fires in the capital.

item.title: Mauritanian minister orders Zouerate hospital work accelerated
item.description: Mamoudou Mamadou Niang inspected ongoing construction at the regional hospital and schools in Zouerate.

item.title: Mauritanian navy saves 134 migrants near Nouadhibou
item.description: The migrants, including women and children, were en route to the Canary Islands when intercepted.
